description:
Update the pricing and availability of specific products in the Urban Electronics store to meet new Q2 requirements.

1. Find the 'Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones' (SKU: SONY-WH1000XM5) and reduce its price to $329.99.
2. Find the 'Logitech MX Master 3S' (SKU: LOGI-MXM3S) and reduce its price to $79.99.
3. Find the 'Bose QuietComfort 45' (SKU: BOSE-QC45). This item is discontinued; unpublish it to remove it from the storefront (do not delete it).

Start from the Products list in the Commerce administration section.
